scope: Source inventory and named executable cases, not a line/branch coverage percentage or port acceptance. Full state calls are host observations subject to source undefined behavior.

jpl_get_double.status: Aligned start/end/step selected; packed AU/EMRAT sanitizer diagnostics; arbitrary offsets and type-punning misuse undefined, not goldens.

jpl_get_long.status: All 45 IPT slots and declared integer scalar getters; signed int32 load promoted to host long. Arbitrary/unaligned offsets not executed.

jpl_pleph.status: Targets 1-17, mixed centre rules, Earth/Moon special pair, SSB/EMB/Sun, zero/nonzero velocity, invalid/equal indices, optional absence and failure/recovery. Failed output suppressed. Private uninitialized arrays and out-of-range pointer formation preclude portable full-call numerical goldens.

interp.status: Initialized helper: ncf 1/2/5/17, dimensions 1/2/3, intervals 1/2/8, flags 1/2/3, endpoints and interior; exact polynomial diagnostic. State snapshots cover interval 4 and derivative/time cache demands. ncf=0 with velocity and arbitrary malformed inputs remain unsafe/unexecuted.

swap_32_bit_val.status: Known byte pattern plus both header orders.

swap_64_bit_val.status: Two-word pattern, headers/constants/full records, and skipped swap after short reads. Negative count misuse not executed.

dimension.status: Indices 0-15; 11 maps to 2 and 14 to 1, otherwise 3. Kernel sizing uses IPT index; state interpolation uses i+1.

jpl_state.status: All 14 list entries, barycentric/heliocentric, Sun 9 values/cache, shared optional destination, exact/adjacent endpoints, all returned errors applicable to state. Controlled unwritten fields do not cure line 625 pointer UB; full-call numbers are host observations.

jpl_init_error_code.status: Startup -9, all defined init status codes, non-null -7/-8, successful recovery/reset, unchanged after close. Concurrent access not tested.

jpl_init_ephemeris.status: Real DE405; both synthetic byte orders; pre430, extended <=400 and >400, special 400 scan, malformed extended offsets, title/header discrepancy, ratio and missing/short inputs; nam/val four combinations. libc seek/read/allocation failure injection identified separately from filesystem failures. Unwritten temp_data fields retained.

jpl_close_ephemeris.status: Successful and non-null-error handles closed and reopened. Null/double close, leak instrumentation and concurrency not tested.

jpl_get_constant.status: Negative/end indices, first/last, 399/400/401 names, byte order, short values and ignored seek/read failures; initialized 7-byte caller names. Name/value reads accept any positive byte count, not exact length.

declarations_and_macros.make_sub_ephem: Declared jpleph.h:60, no implementation in pinned checkout; no invented counterpart or executable case.
declarations_and_macros.jpl_get_pvsun: jpleph.h:110 raw base+248 double pointer. Host offsetof(pvsun)=248 and 9 mathematical Sun values observed separately; the macro itself conveys no length, validity or initialization. No substitute getter implementation.

requirements.R1_identity: run.py exports unmodified Git blobs, verifies live equality/hashes, replays the unchanged F/D prior probe in H's build, records compiler/flags and harness hashes.
requirements.R2_layouts: inputs.json declarations plus layout_*; SOURCE_MAP.md lists every field, unit, getter and counterpart.
requirements.R3_queries: state_sequences_*, pleph_pairs_*, de405_full, helper_interpolation and zero_coefficients; full arrays include untouched sentinels.
requirements.R4_failure: init_*, seek_failure_recovery, read_failure_before_first_success, de405_truncated_*, partial_cache_*, partial_far_* and isolated.json.
requirements.R5_lifetime_U1: lifetime_replace_*, lifetime_overwrite_*, u1_preflight_reopen_*; fstat/stat inode equality, cached/uncached/reopen behavior and stdio read-ahead recorded. Adjacent record: recsize=6600, 137 bytes remain on disk, fread(size=8,count=825) returns 85 items (680 bytes), statuses 0,-2,0 and cache unchanged on retry. Central independently reproduced this and directs the later port to retain a minimal bounded C-stdio I/O wrapper while moving headers/state/interpolation to Rust; H makes no production change or production-wrapper race claim.
requirements.R6_verification: Exact ordered regeneration, decimal-to-bits checks, paired endian observations, independent rational helper diagnostic, nine artifact mutations and five compiled source mutations. Isolated failures gate status, parsed failure kind and completed stage; pinned source locations are asserted when available (required for UBSan/assertions). Variable symbolized/unsymbolized trace summaries are separate evidence. Nine focused comparator tests include wrong kind/stage mutations and both recorded trace presentations.
requirements.U2_alignment: Layout evidence, packed-field access contract and isolated UBSan AU/EMRAT errors. No unaligned getter number exported as a portable oracle.

unexecuted_or_nonportable: Only macOS arm64 (LP64, little-endian hardware) executed. Big-endian file encoding is tested on this host; big-endian hardware, Linux, Windows, 32-bit ABI and other real ephemerides are untested.
Unwritten pvsun_t/pvsun/interpolation fields and swapped pre430 temporary bytes have no portable initializer values. No MemorySanitizer availability or natural-init numerical validity is claimed.

Source pointer formation at jpleph.c:625 is UBSan-diagnosed even in controlled state. Source :639 also transiently forms pv[14] in pleph's 13-row allocation; it is separately source-inspected, not separately sanitizer-isolated.

Position-only EMB copy at :216 copies unwritten velocity slots. Failed ordinary pleph at :203 continues using unwritten locals. Sanitizer does not prove their initialization; outputs on failure are suppressed.
Public nut[4] documentation is insufficient for six-value libration/mantle requests. H's normal harness deliberately supplies six slots; isolated four-slot probe reports ASan overflow.
Malformed NaN/tiny-step epoch conversion, oversized coefficient offsets, unterminated title and ncf=18 are isolated; there is no portable numerical result after the recorded failure stage.

ncf=0 derivative underflow, invalid/negative list flags, zero/negative/overflowed record layouts, invalid getter offsets, null/double-close, signed count overflow and arbitrary malformed offset combinations are not exhaustively executed.
Ordinary seek failures and allocation failure are injected at libc boundaries, not OS disk/resource exhaustion. Partial reads and live file replacements/overwrites are real filesystem operations.
Concurrent file writers, global init-error races, multiprocess ordering, permission-denied access, directory/FIFO streams, fclose errors and file-descriptor leak counts are untested.
Partial binary64 elements have indeterminate C values; raw observed bytes and full-call outputs remain host observations. stdio buffered bytes are platform/runtime-dependent.
No top-level TEMPO2 timing orchestration, SOFA, Rust implementation, fitting, port numerical budgets or milestone acceptance is included.
